sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (illustrations show ₹3,00,000; policy schedule determines actual SI)

room_rent.display: 1% of SI/day (upgradable to Single Private AC Room via optional rider)
room_rent.note: Base cover: 1% of SI per day. Optional Benefit 'Room Rent Modification' upgrades to Single Private AC Room (only for SI < ₹5L). If room taken is higher than eligible, ratable proportion of associate medical expenses borne by insured.

icu.display: 2% of SI/day (upgradable to no limit via optional rider)
icu.note: Base cover: 2% of SI per day. Optional Benefit 'Room Rent Modification' upgrades ICU to no limit (only for SI < ₹5L).

copayment.display: None (base); 20% if non-network hospital under Smart Select add-on; optional co-pay for age 61+
copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay in base policy. Optional Benefit 'Smart Select' imposes 20% co-pay for non-network hospitals. Optional Benefit 'Co-Payment Option' applies co-pay to insured persons aged 61+ as specified in policy schedule.

sub_limits.display: Few sub-limits; room rent and ICU capped; specific disease sub-limits possible per schedule
sub_limits.note: Room rent capped at 1% SI/day; ICU at 2% SI/day (base). Disease/procedure sub-limits may apply as per policy schedule. Domiciliary hospitalization excludes certain diseases (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, etc.).

deductible.note: No deductible in base policy. Optional Benefit 'Deductible Option' allows insured to opt for a deductible (amount per policy schedule) in exchange for premium discount; applied on aggregate basis per policy year.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt.

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing diseases covered after 36 months of continuous coverage. Portability credits apply.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions include arthritis, ENT surgeries, BPH, cataract, D&C, fissure/fistula/piles, GU surgery, hernia, hysterectomy, tumours/cysts, kidney/gall stones, myomectomy, varicose veins, Parkinson's/Alzheimer's/dementia.

maternity.note: Optional Benefit 'Maternity and New Born Baby Cover'; 24-month waiting period; max 2 living children per insured lifetime; primary insured or spouse only; age limit 45 years at policy start; limit as per policy schedule.

cumulative_bonus.note: 50% of base SI added per claim-free year (or if total claims ≤25% of base SI). Max 200% of SI. Bonus reduced at same rate if claims exceed 25% of base SI. Unlimited Automatic Recharge and Inflation Shield not counted for CB calculation.

restoration.note: Unlimited Automatic Recharge: base SI reinstated unlimited times per policy year after base SI + Cumulative Bonus + Inflation Shield exhausted. Can be used for same illness (except Any One Illness condition). Available for hospitalisation, pre/post-hosp, ambulance, domiciliary, and maternity benefits.

domiciliary.note: Covered up to amount in policy schedule. Excludes asthma, bronchitis, chronic nephritis, diarrhoea/dysentery, diabetes, epilepsy, hypertension, influenza/cough/cold, psychiatric disorders, pyrexia of unknown origin, tonsillitis/URTI, arthritis/gout/rheumatism.

ayush.note: Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Siddha, Unani, Homeopathy covered up to sum insured as per policy schedule; requires in-patient admission at recognised AYUSH hospital.

organ_donor.note: Medical expenses of donor for organ transplant surgery covered up to amount in policy schedule. Post-harvest expenses of donor not covered.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to amount specified in policy schedule. Air ambulance also covered as separate benefit up to amount in policy schedule.

modern_treatments.note: Advance technology methods covered: uterine artery embolization, HIFU, balloon sinuplasty, deep brain stimulation, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy (monoclonal antibody injections), intravitreal injections, robotic surgeries, stereotactic radio surgeries, bronchial thermoplasty, vaporisation of prostate (green/holmium laser), IONM, stem cell therapy (haematopoietic for bone marrow transplant). Other advance technology methods excluded.

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable items listed in Annexure I are excluded. No optional rider for consumables mentioned.

global_cover.note: Policy covers medical treatment taken entirely within India. International Second Opinion is available as optional benefit but is not treatment cover.

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years, no look-back applies except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions. Moratorium applies to base SI; fresh 5-year period starts from date of SI enhancement for enhanced portion.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 15 days for monthly premium payment mode and 30 days for all other modes.

free_look.note: Applicable on new individual health insurance policies only, not on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: Apply to new insurer at least 30 days before but not earlier than 60 days from renewal date. Continuity benefits for waiting periods transferred as per IRDAI guidelines.

notable_exclusions.display: Consumables/non-medical items (Annexure I), STDs (except HIV-related), hormone replacement therapy, tobacco/alcohol-related illness, experimental treatments, external prosthetics, cosmetic surgery

optional_riders.display: Maternity & New Born Cover, Daily Allowance, Smart Select (network discount+20% co-pay outside network), Deductible Option, Co-Payment Option (age 61+), Room Rent Modification (SI<5L), International Second Opinion
